title: Paradise Watersports
specs: Largest jet ski riding area in Ocean City with little boat traffic
Tiki party boat includes Bluetooth sound system, cooler with ice, and bathroom
Pontoon boats suitable for fishing, floating, restaurant/bar hopping, and sandbar hangs
Center console boats have T-top for shade and built-in rod holders for fishing
Must be 16 years old to rent jet ski; under 18 requires parent/guardian signature
Jet ski drivers must present valid photo ID with birthdate
Jet ski riders up to 3 people, max 450 lbs
Must be 21+ to book public tiki party boat; private charters allow under 21 with guardian
All ages welcome on pontoon boats; driver must be 18+ with valid ID

blurb: Guests can rent jet skis, pontoon boats, center console fishing boats, and tiki party boats, or take parasailing flights and safari boat tours. Rentals include safety briefings and temporary boating licenses where required. Activities range from 1 hour jet ski rides to multi-hour boat rentals and parasailing flights.
